marbleMaze.name: Marble maze
marbleMaze.description: A marble to roll through a maze into its hole by tipping the frame (its accelerometer): it rolls and bounces on a fast screen, and moves a corridor at a time on e-paper. Swipes and arrow keys move it too, a corridor at a time.
